title: Dove son?
subtitle: Dorabella, Don Alfonso and Fiordiligi: recitative from Così fan tutte, Act 1

licences.source: W. A. Mozart, Così fan tutte, K. 588 (1790), Act 1 scene 6, recitative after No. 9
licences.author: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart (1756–1791)

licences.source: Lorenzo Da Ponte, libretto of Così fan tutte (1790)
licences.author: Lorenzo Da Ponte (1749–1838)
licences.notes: Words as printed in the Peters vocal score (Oh Dei).

licences.source: Edition Peters vocal score (Edition Peters Nr. 4474, plate 11446, edited by Georg Schünemann), pages 63–64, the recitative between No. 9 and No. 10 (17 bars)
licences.author: Kurt Soldan (1891–1946), piano reduction
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: sung lines and piano each read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the page by a judge, then checked bar by bar by a fresh checker (notes clean; one word break fixed in bar 17, me gli a-mi-ci). The German singing translation is left out, and a handwritten pencil correction over bar 14 is ignored. The last bar leads straight into No. 10 (attacca). Playback tempo ♩ = 64, a speaking pace for secco recitative, from Rattle (1:05) and Klemperer (1:03); Mozart gives no tempo.

licences.source: Written for this app (from the app's reviewed Così libretto drafts)
